notes: Admin Notes are now a real history, and adding a note no longer risks erasing notes written elsewhere. Moderation song view redesigned and more compact, with Artist Web Search, Account Risk Assessment, and automatic ACR/Shazam results. Errors now explain what went wrong and what to do instead of showing bare codes. Other Songs shows the artist's whole catalog, hotkeys persist through restarts, and the Moderation navigation can be collapsed.

windows_notes: Errors now explain what went wrong and what to do instead of showing a bare code like HTTP 521. Your saved hotkeys now persist through restarts and updates, and Mail's 1-9 folder shortcuts are finally saved. Other Songs shows the artist's whole catalog and marks Freecords-only releases. Fixed the shortcuts overlay (cut-off F-key row, Ctrl+number recording), Approve Silent falling outside its column, and removed sideways scrolling from Moderation.
